TEST MENU

The test menu allows you to test various functions of the game and configure settings used in the game. These items include input devices such as joysticks, buttons and coin mechs, output devices such as monitor, speakers and meters. Through the test menu you can also access the configuration menu, where you can change the settings of the game.
